subject: Pilot launch: infra access & API key procurement
messages:
From: Claire Novak <claire@novushealth.com>
To: david.kim@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: procure@novushealth.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot launch: infra access & API key procurement

Hi David / Monica,

We're excited to get the pilot with Redwood started. Before we lock in the kickoff call, our procurement and engineering teams need a concrete list of what you need from us to enable the initial tenant and API access. High-level asks below — let me know if anything's missing.

Quick background: Novus Health will pilot Redwood inference for a clinical-search feature (low volume, PII scrubbed). The pilot scope is one workspace with 3 engineer seats and 1 admin.

What we need from Redwood:
- A short mutual action plan / timeline for tenant provisioning and admin invites (we expect a 2-week window).
- Temporary API key vs seeded admin API key: which route do you recommend for a timeboxed pilot?
- Names/roles we need to provide to seed admin invites and the exact project/namespace naming convention.
- Security checklist: what evidence will you need (SOC2 scope statements, key handling notes)?
- Procurement: contact for PO and SOW countersign (cc'd: procure@novushealth.com).

I attached the signed SOW for reference.

We'd appreciate a short checklist and a proposed kickoff window next week. Thanks — Claire

Attachments: Novus-SOW.pdf (SOW, 3 pages)

Regards,
Claire Novak
Director of Product
Novus Health
claire@novushealth.com
From: david.kim@redwood.com <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Claire Novak <claire@novushealth.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot launch: infra access & API key procurement

Claire — thanks for the clear list. Looping Monica and Irene from CS/Implementation to scope the onboarding steps.

Attached is a one-page mutual action plan (MAP-draft.xlsx) that maps required inputs from Novus to Redwood deliverables. High-level answers to your bullets below: 

- Tenant provisioning & timeline: We can stand up a dedicated workspace (tenant) within 2 business days once we have the admin user list and project names. Full pilot readiness (keys, sample routing, QA) is typically 7–10 business days. 
- API key approach: For a short pilot we recommend a time-limited seeded admin API key (scoped to a single project/namespace) — faster and avoids tenant admin invites for initial eval. For production or anything crossing PHI boundaries, we'll switch to per-user keys and KMS-backed secrets.
- What we need from you: admin user emails (3), preferred project/namespace slug, and a primary PO contact for billing.
- Security evidence: we'll provide SOC2 Type II summary, encryption-at-rest notes, and an access-audit sample. Irene will follow up with the precise artifacts and timeline.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Claire — share admin emails + project slug + PO contact by EOD Monday.
2) We provision tenant and seed a time-limited admin API key; share creds in a secure DocuSign / secrets channel.
3) Kickoff call: 30 minutes to walk through access, role mapping, and initial telemetry — propose Tue 06/22 10:00–10:30 PT.

I'll leave detailed technical sequencing to Monica.

Thanks,
David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: MAP-draft.xlsx (1 sheet, mutual action plan)
From: monica.patel@redwood.com <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Claire Novak <claire@novushealth.com>
Cc: david.kim@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot launch: infra access & API key procurement

Hi Claire — thank you. Below is a concise onboarding playbook we will follow for the pilot tenant and access provisioning. I'm copying the artifacts we will attach and the exact asks so your security and procurement teams can review.

Onboarding playbook (pilot — single workspace, 3 eng seats + 1 admin):

1) Pre-provisioning (what we need from Novus)
   - Admin emails (CSV) — column: email, first_name, last_name, role (admin/engineer).
   - Preferred namespace/project slug (e.g., novus-clinical-pilot).
   - PO contact and billing email for the SOW.
   - Tenant inventory (if you have existing API consumers) — optional; attach tenant_inventory.csv if available.

2) Redwood actions (T+0 to T+2 business days)
   - Create workspace & project with provided slug.
   - Seed a time-limited admin API key scoped to the pilot project (valid 21 days by default). If you want a shorter TTL, tell us and we will adjust.
   - Pre-populate role templates: admin, developer, read-only. We will add the 3 engineers as 'developer' and 1 admin as 'admin'.
   - Share API key via secure link and create an audit entry for the key issuance.

3) Security & compliance handoff (T+1 to T+5)
   - Irene will drop SOC2 and encryption notes into the shared folder and confirm KMS options for production.
   - We'll enable audit logging for the pilot tenant; logs retained per the SOW.

4) Kickoff + verification (T+2 to T+7)
   - 30-min kickoff to confirm access, run a sample inference call, and verify telemetry: latency, token usage, and error rates.
   - We will provide a sample cURL and SDK snippet and a short checklist for smoke testing.

Security notes (short):
- Seeded admin key is for pilot only; we recommend rotating to per-user keys before production.
- If you require HSM-backed keys, that is available for the private deployment track and will require a procurement addendum.

Sample commands (example):
- cURL (test endpoint):
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/projects/novus-clinical-pilot/generate \
    -H \"Authorization: Bearer <SEE_SECURE_LINK>\" \
    -d '{\"prompt\":\"Hello world\"}'

Attached: MAP-draft.xlsx, tenant_inventory.csv (if you have it)

On a process note: please send admin emails in the CSV; we will not seed individual invites from a free text email list to avoid typos and delays.

On Tue 06/22 at 10:00 PT works for the kickoff — we'll send a calendar invite once we have the admin list.

Best,
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead | Customer Success, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
